## Buses wander, trams do not

These illustrative journey times come from 18 trips on each route. Every dot is one trip, stacked in 30 equal intervals of journey time.

```chart
type: dotplot
title: Trams run to time, buses wander
subtitle: Journey time by route, 18 trips each

encoding: {x: minutes, color: route}
axes:

  y: {label: Trips}
```

Use the keyboard or pointer to read how many trips fall in each interval.
